title: Searching for PayPal webhooks subscription is blocking the Cloud Migration
summary: PayPal webhook subscription search now uses SetFilter placeholders to handle special characters robustly while maintaining case-insensitive matching, preventing cloud migration blocking.
key_points: Uses placeholders in SetFilter for safer special character handling
Improves robustness of PayPal webhook management
Low-risk change with test coverage added
quote: Using placeholders in SetFilter makes it more robust with regards to special characters.
